steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Did we succeed?!

The healing speed can't catch up with the consumption, and the puppets have broken into pieces. The lake looks like it can no longer hold the weight of truth, so with their last breaths, the puppets' wreckage slowly sinks into the water.
The men in black raincoats have disappeared and Phantom Hamel's unsettling laughter is completely gone as well.
On the tainted stage of the lake, only the frail Dancer is still dancing slowly.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Thought it would be like that time with Zoya, once we destroy her, the Black Ring will shatter. But in the end, we can't even touch her, she's just like a hologram.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Do we have to find the power supply and unplug it or something to make her stop? To make this fake amusement park disappear?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: She won't last much longer, it should end very soon.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: We need to be prepared. Once the illusory realm falls apart, who knows what this place will become, and how many enemies will show up.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Alright, alright, you take care of the preparation then. I'm pooped, I wanna watch the girl dance.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Just as an illusion... it's actually very enjoyable. I guess we won't get to see this anymore.
Hamel's body is growing more and more transparent, her movements slow and weak, even the hem of her white dress is slowly fading.
You walk toward her once again. Unaware of your presence, she doesn't hear your voice, doesn't see your body. Her brow is slightly furrowed, as if still not freed from the previous pain.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Only those with souls can feel pain.

steps.content: You're more than just a hollow phantom illusion... Are you here, Hamel?

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: The Dancer doesn't need to be greeted. She only needs to dance. We'll be her audience.
Perhaps she's never been greeted before.
She can feel the audience, she can feel the stage, and she experiences the world through the stage as well. The mascots indulged in her illusory realm, just as she indulges in her own dance.
Now, this dance is coming to an end too. You step closer to her. You still wish to talk to the dancer, you still have many things to ask her, perhaps that's the only way...

You take Hamel's hands. At first, her hands keep slipping through your palms, and it feels like they come from another dimension. Gradually, you catch up with the rhythm and understand the emotions in the steps... You are catching up with her.
As the surrounding sounds are slowly fading, you finally grip her hands. After a dazed moment, Hamel's lowered gaze finally lands on you.

You have many questions for her. Where is the real her? How is she related to that black thing? Has she been holding up this illusory realm all by herself? For 23 years, or an even longer, twisted period of time?
Is she... still alive?
But the gradually fading pair of hands is telling you that you're running out of time.
No one needs your protection anymore here.
She doesn't answer. Those clear rose-red eyes are staring at you, asking...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Me? I don't need protection from the illusory realm.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Even if there's a dark hollow in my heart, I don't need to fill it with anything. I will carry it and keep on fighting.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Dance for yourself, Hamel. I don't need you to protect me from hell.
Hamel gives you a gentle, sad smile. You hear her speak for the first time.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: You can do it... After all, you're different...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: You... are not alone...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This voice... She's the person guiding me in the illusory realm?
Hamel lifts a hand to caress your cheek, healing all your wounds with the last bit of her power, her figure slowly growing transparent.
Until she fades away.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hamel has disappeared...
As Hamel's body vanishes completely, the illusory realm is also beginning to shatter.
Like a rotten ceiling, the bright and clear sky is crumbling bit by bit, revealing the true appearance of the Carnival...
Under the cover of the red light, the dark world is filled with fear, pain and evil.

steps.speaker: Carnival Corruptor
steps.content: Aaahhh!

steps.speaker: Carnival Corruptor
steps.content: Pain... Pain... No... Help... Help...

steps.speaker: Carnival Corruptor
steps.content: Ahhh! Die... Die...

Now that Hamel's illusory realm is gone, the whole Carnival looks like it's going through an earthquake. Roars can be heard everywhere and the Corruptors have ripped off their fake skins, losing control completely.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Hamel?! Is that you, Hamel?!

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Has the parade ended? Can I finally see you?!
Staggering, he stands up, crushing the last bit of blue light protecting him. He stumbles toward the flaring amusement park.
On top of the decayed Ferris wheel, the black illusion is peering down at everything below joyfully.

steps.speaker: Black Illusion
steps.content: Hahahaha! I'm free...!

steps.speaker: Black Illusion
steps.content: Come, come to my park, come and find true happiness. Stay with me, love me...!

steps.speaker: Black Illusion
steps.content: Come to the <color=#fb9259>real Endless Carnival</color>!
She spreads her arms to embrace the sky. The enormous red luminous ring overlooks everything. The first Black Ring of the DisCity has finally revealed its original form.

steps.speaker: Communications 04
steps.content: Black Ring BR-001 is confirmed to have gone out of control. Cases of mental abnormalities have occurred in both the East and West Districts, all moving in the direction of BR-001. The isolation belt of the Rust is already being breached!

steps.speaker: Communications 01
steps.content: This hasn't happened in 23 years. Why has it suddenly gone out of control?

steps.speaker: Communications 04
steps.content: It's <color=#fb9259>that person from the MBCC</color>! He violated the regulations and entered BR-001 ten minutes ago, and now this has happened!
steps.female_content: It's <color=#fb9259>that person from the MBCC</color>! She violated the regulations and entered BR-001 ten minutes ago, and now this has happened!

steps.speaker: Communications 04
steps.content: He really is colluding with those people. Their purpose is to sabotage the FAC's defense and free BR-001!
steps.female_content: She really is colluding with those people. Their purpose is to sabotage the FAC's defense and free BR-001!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: This accusation is baseless. You don't even have proof that an accident has indeed happened in the Ring. Chief was there to destroy the Black Ring, he must still be fighting.
steps.female_content: This accusation is baseless. You don't even have proof that an accident has indeed happened in the Ring. Chief was there to destroy the Black Ring, she must still be fighting.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Instead of holding it against the MBCC, why don't you do your job? Strengthen the defense at the Rust to prevent affected citizens from entering that area.

steps.speaker: Communications 04
steps.content: You...!

steps.speaker: Communications 01
steps.content: ...Any news from the 9th Agency? That person was sent in there by them, and they're the ones monitoring the power behind the Black Ring. <color=#fb9259>That woman</color> hasn't offered any explanation yet?

steps.speaker: Communications 04
steps.content: ...She's just... declined communications from the meeting.

Langley is standing outside the Black Ring. The dark red light surging in the Black Ring keeps spreading outward. She presses the button to decline the call request and simply throws the device to her subordinate behind her.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Got no time for that. What's going on at the FAC?

steps.speaker: Intelligence Agent
steps.content: The eavesdropper's sent updates. There have been data irregularities in the BR-001 defense network. Significant fluctuations were observed near both the shielding base stations E1 and E2. Moments ago, someone entered the Black Ring.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Haha... I knew it. I was busy doing something else last time, I can't miss another chance.
The moth has flown into the web. The Silver Spider takes out her gun.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Time to meet the old friend...
Heh, quite the talker... just like <color=#fb9259>Victor</color>.
The black flames are burning, and men in black raincoats are forming from the shadow behind him.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: I'll thank you for eliminating this fake illusory realm for me this time. No one can get in my way now, let's get to work.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: Let's go and welcome the free <color=#fb9259>Corpus</color>...
Evading the red contamination, he walks into the park illuminated by the Black Ring. This time, no one is banishing him again.
